source_row.rationale: Methylergonovine causes significant vasoconstriction as part of its uterotonic effect, and is contraindicated in clients with hypertension or preeclampsia, since it can further and dangerously elevate blood pressure. The nurse should verify blood pressure history before this medication is administered and monitor closely if given.
